purpose: An evidence-led mechanism registry, not a source-code archive or a visual-style preset.
sourceRights: Historical reference sources and media are not redistributed; only independently authored mechanics, analysis and demos are published.

mechanisms.problem: Multiple evidence views disagree or lose their selected context.
recipe: Store the active evidence ID in one state model, not per component.
Derive status, explanation, and selected controls from that state.
Use native controls with a visible active label.
Handle keyboard, focus, and hash/deep-link needs independently of animations.
mechanisms.fallback: Present every claim with its explanation in a semantic list; selection is progressive enhancement.
rejectWhen: No verified claims exist, or state changes cannot be explained in text.

mechanisms.problem: A meaningful atmospheric field needs Canvas/WebGL but must not consume idle resources.
recipe: Render a factual or explicitly illustrative field behind semantic content.
Cap device pixel ratio and schedule one animation loop only.
Pause when hidden or offscreen; resume on visibility changes.
Handle context loss, unsupported graphics, and cleanup.
mechanisms.fallback: Use a licensed static still or simple SVG with the same information.
rejectWhen: The visual adds no meaning, low-power performance is critical, or assets are unlicensed.

mechanisms.problem: A real sequence needs a temporal relationship between scroll, text and a diagram.
recipe: Model actual stages and transitions before writing scroll code.
Compute clamped section progress from geometry in one function.
Derive labels, active stage and diagram from that progress.
Verify reverse scroll, short-height and touch; never block normal scrolling.
mechanisms.fallback: Provide the complete sequence in ordinary document order without sticky locking.
rejectWhen: There is no meaningful staged relationship, or sticky scrolling delays essential information.

mechanisms.problem: A visually pinned narrative must remain usable without movement and scripting.
recipe: Write a complete document-first sequence.
Treat pinning and animation as optional enhanced presentation.
In reduced-motion mode restore auto height and relative/statically positioned sections.
Test focus, reading order, and back-navigation.
mechanisms.fallback: The ordinary document flow is the primary implementation and never disappears.
rejectWhen: Never reject a working linear fallback; reject only if it introduces worse order or hides content.

mechanisms.problem: An authentic image needs controlled exposure to explain a change or a discovery.
recipe: Identify exactly what the photograph proves.
Design the baseline full image, descriptive caption, and meaningful crop.
Progressively add an inset/circle mask tied to a clear trigger.
Keep labels readable at both endpoints and throughout the transition.
mechanisms.fallback: Show full still images and their captions without aperture effects.
rejectWhen: Visual source has no provenance or the reveal adds atmosphere but no information.

mechanisms.problem: Graph, narration and process readout must represent one actual data model.
recipe: Define units, values, source and interpolation assumptions.
Compute process phase and plotted values from one pure function.
Use the same function for graphic, selection and textual readout.
Offer an accessible table/text interpretation for every represented value.
mechanisms.fallback: Show a sourced table or an ordered qualitative process when numerical data are unavailable.
rejectWhen: Only hypothetical numbers exist or a graph would create false precision.

mechanisms.problem: An unusual display lockup must fit real content at variable widths and font states.
recipe: Use semantic heading content and a fluid CSS baseline.
Measure rendered overflow only after font/layout readiness.
Update only necessary properties and debounce layout changes.
Test 200 percent zoom, 320px reflow and missing-font fallback.
mechanisms.fallback: Allow the original heading to wrap naturally without JS or measured scaling.
rejectWhen: It depends on shrinking meaningful text below readable sizes.

mechanisms.problem: Actual moving work needs video without sacrificing first-load clarity.
recipe: Identify the video’s informational benefit over a still.
Use a licensed poster, captions or transcript where appropriate.
Respect motion preferences and data/bandwidth constraints.
Provide accessible play/pause controls when sound or duration matters.
mechanisms.fallback: Use the poster image, transcript and direct work link if playback is unavailable.
rejectWhen: The footage is illustrative but presented as proof of client work or is licensed ambiguously.

mechanisms.problem: Details need an accessible temporary focus context rather than an inert overlay.
recipe: Prefer a native dialog when modal behavior is needed.
Open on deliberate activation; track the invoking element.
Close on Escape and explicit control; restore focus.
Ensure the backdrop does not conceal the only path to essential details.
mechanisms.fallback: Use a normal linked details page or inline expandable section.
rejectWhen: A modal interrupts a job better served by a stable detail page.

mechanisms.problem: An instructional overlay must follow actual elements, not an invented coordinate sketch.
recipe: Render complete real HTML before measuring.
After fonts are ready, measure explicitly annotated elements.
Map measurements to an SVG overlay, including scroll offsets and transforms.
Re-measure on resize and content change; cancel observers on teardown.
mechanisms.fallback: Show the finished artifact immediately, with optional plan illustration in ordinary content.
rejectWhen: The animation delays access or the measured targets are not stable.

mechanisms.problem: A multi-stage reveal must have explicit phases, cancellation and completion guarantees.
recipe: Specify named phases and legal transitions before animation.
Use monotonic elapsed time or explicit events instead of chained arbitrary delays.
Permit skip, abort and direct completion without losing content.
Clean up timers/listeners, support repeated mounts and reduced motion.
mechanisms.fallback: Start in the completed content state; reveal is never a loading dependency.
rejectWhen: It extends a wait for content already available.

mechanisms.problem: Dates and milestones must remain consistent across multiple navigation representations.
recipe: Store sourced milestones in one sorted canonical array.
Map scroll and direct selection to one active index.
Keep details and active semantics synchronized with that index.
Use a semantic linear timeline for screen readers, reduced motion and no JS.
mechanisms.fallback: Show the full chronology as an ordered list of dated items and source links.
rejectWhen: The chronology is too short or too dense to justify a spatial navigator.
